guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Special (Marley) / Fender Stratocaster (Marvin)
guitar.notes: Marley famously played a Gibson Les Paul Special (and also Washburn/Ovation acoustics at times); this is reasonably well known, keeping medium confidence is fair given some variation.

tone.target: warm clean reggae rhythm with light spring room
tone.profile: warm clean reggae rhythm with light spring room
tone.summary: A classic reggae rhythm tone achieved using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe), light compression for punchy attack, and subtle room/spring ambience to capture the warm, dry feel of the original recording.
